notes:
No theme in this batch sits under another playable theme (parents are Qualities categories), so nothing is separate. Kept as non-modern-fiction: Santa, Pegasus, Cupid, Icarus, Dracula, Moby Dick, Bagheera (Kipling 1894), Robin Hood, Snow White, Little Red Riding Hood, Black Beauty (1877), leprechaun, Krampus, Baphomet, Pan, Grim Reaper, tooth fairy, crocodile in things that tick (Peter Pan's, public-domain reference). Removed Tinker Bell, Tigger, Winnie the Pooh and Zorro as heavily trademarked even where the source book is public domain in the US. Kept toy/brand names (Beyblade, Slinky, Lego man, Post-it, Pop Rocks, Mylar, Swarovski, Segway, Vespa, Brompton, X-Acto knife, Hot Wheels). Left lowercase as dictionaries do: popsicle, salchow, axel, lutz, crepe, serac, zorb, superball. Kept 'eight ball' in black things (common spelling). zipper got uk 'zip'. Colour themes lost many cartoon characters (blue things went 50 -> 44 after additions).
Restored at the owner's request (video games and copyrighted novels allowed): Sonic (fast things), Pikachu (yellow things), Pac-Man (yellow things), Sonic (blue things), Koopa (things with shells)
